product_description: Yvette Adjustable High Impact Sports Bra Designed for high-intensity workouts like running, HIIT, and CrossFit, this front-zip sports bra combines convenience with reliable support. The durable zipper features scratch-proof protection and a soft inner lining to prevent irritation—just zip on and off with ease, no more struggling over your head after a sweaty session. Customizable fit comes from adjustable shoulder straps, while the engineered racerback design with mesh lining relieves back pressure and maximizes airflow. The molded cups stay securely in place—no shifting, no bunching, and no lost padding during washing. Full coverage construction eliminates top and side spillage, making it ideal for larger busts.

top_reviews.title: Supports proper posture! I love it!
top_reviews.body: I wear a DDD or an H, 5’5” 168# so I got an xxl in this sports bra, I love it but my next one I’ll get an xl because it could be a little tighter around the band. Otherwise it is very supportive, and compresses my breasts firmly against my chest. It is very comfortable, the material is soft. The zipper is something to get used to, I found that laying back on my bed to zip it works best for me. There’s a flap of material that lays over the top of the zipper so there is protection from skin irritation. This sports bra improves my posture as the weight of my breasts cause me to be hunched forward, with the support of this bra I am able to maintain and upright posture which is exactly what I was hoping for. I am 65 and I’m definitely happy with it and am going to buy more

top_reviews.title: Great, comfortable bra. DD can run 3 miles comfortably in this.
top_reviews.body: I have had many Yvette bras, they're my go to brand for larger sizing. I purchased an XL Plus and it's a great fit. I am 5'7 and 190 pounds with a DD cup size. I normally wear a size L unisex shirt. This fits me well and I run 3 miles a day in this bra, it has great support. I loved it so much that I bought a second one. The comfort is great, the fabric is soft and thick enough for me and the zipper stays put. The straps don't dig in. I have a problem of getting headaches when wearing sports bras because of the pressure on my shoulders. This bra does not give me that problem and that alone makes it worth 5 stars to me. Its easy to put on, washes well and overall it's a great bra. It is definitely worth the money IMO.

top_reviews.title: Good Support
top_reviews.body: This is a very comfortable sports bra with one feature that needs to be improved. There is no fabric to cover the bottom part of the zipper, there is for the top of the zipper. After several hours of wear, that little spot in the bottom middle of the sports bra can be irratating, It could be easily fixed with a small fabric zipper cover. This one has adjustable straps which is important for a proper fit, and the straps lay on the shoulds, and do not dig into the side of the neck like some sports bras can. One star off for not covering the bottom part of the zipper and you may not receive a new sports bra. I have been receiving more and more items that have been returned to Amazon and resent to me, which show signs of wear, some damage, or some manufacuring error. I never know if I will receive a new item. One other important note: this sports bra does run small as other reviewers have mentioned. Use the size chart to find your size, then go up one size. Update: I reordered one of these sports bras, as I received a used one. Unfortunately, the replacement was also a used, not new bra. You will taake your chances of getting a new bra. Amazon did accept the return and will credit my account.

top_reviews.title: Very supportive for serious workouts!
top_reviews.body: I wear this frequently for my CrossFit workout. Easy to put on & off, comfortable and supportive. Use size chart, mine fit comfortably.

top_reviews.title: Too tight.
top_reviews.body: I followed the size directions, but it doesn't fit and needs to go back. I got the 4XL Plus. My current bras that fit me well are a 46 band from a reputable company fitted at a reputable store. The 4XL Plus says it is for 46 band size, D to DDD (or F) cup size. I'm an H. I expected the cups to be tight, but I could not find a better sized bra that suited my purpose. I did not expect the band to be so tight I could hardly breathe. The instructions that came with the bra suggested that if you are having difficulty zipping it, lean forward 45 degrees. For me that made things worse as the girls were even more in the way. Lieing flat on my back helped a little. Ultimately, I ended up zipping it while not wearing it and pulled it over my head like a regular sports bra. The instructions also mentioned something about a hooks feature that might be available on some of their front zip bras, making them easier to zip. I did not notice such an option in this Amazon listing. Both in the listing and the literature that was enclosed with the bra the writer's English was poor. It seems to have been written by a non-native speaker. Of course, that would be fine if there were a native English speaker as an editor. Some of what was trying to be communicated is still a mystery to me. By comparison, the item I was planning to replace is size XXXL. I used to think that one was a bit more snug than I really wanted, and would prefer a different color. Now it seems almost perfect because I am comparing it to this one.

top_reviews.title: Best for lymphedema or sports or vigorous workouts
top_reviews.body: I was looking for a bra for both lymphedema compression as well as aerobics support. After trying many, this is by far the best. Lymphedema-wise it supports the entire breast area, under the arm all the way up to the arm pit, and across the back shoulder blades. The soft and thick material feels like the right amount of even compression and the quality seems very high like it will stand up to many washings. The band around the chest is perfectly snug, unlike many that I found, maybe because they have to make it loose enough to get over your shoulders if there's no opening/closure. However, having it be snug to the chest is important in supporting the breasts and keeping movement minimal during high impact exercising/sports. The straps are adjustable which is rare to find in a sports bra as is the zipper front that's easy and helpful to use. Now, to address some complaints... Yes, this bra will not help define your cleavage. However, to get the best compression and/or exercise support, it seems that is what has to be given up, in the design, the material thickness, and zipper front.Unfortunately if you are dealing with lympedema, it's something you have to give up for the better part of a day. After your exercising, or sports play, or for that hot date night, just put on your fave cleavage enhancing bra to go with your sexy outfit. I'm not sure why anyone is complaining about the zipper discomfort. I don't even know it's there. If I were on the design team, I would only look for adding a little tab like the one over zipper to camouflage the strap adjusters, which is the only thing that makes this look like maybe a bra than a sports top. Then add more colors to match outfits, so we lymphedema peoples can wear tops that look like we're layered rather than a colored bra showing on a low neckline :)

top_reviews.title: Runs small
top_reviews.body: This was a well made bra, but I wanted to use it post-surgery, and it was too tight and too stiff for that.

top_reviews.title: Prefect front zip!
top_reviews.body: I’m 66 years old with a very troublesome back, when I discovered the Yvette bras I was thrilled! They zip easily and stay zipped. They fit just right bringing those babies higher. I not only feel supported it feels comfy all day. I own several.
